descriptionChirho: White linen cloth, a fine fabric used especially for priestly garments and sacred vestments in the Tabernacle and Temple service. All occurrences — whether with article ('the linen'), in construct state ('of linen'), singular or plural — refer to the same textile material. Multilingual evidence is uniform: eng 'linen', spa 'lino', hin 'सन/सन का कपड़ा', arb 'كَتَّان', kor '베/세마포', swa 'kitani', consistently denoting fine woven linen fabric.
